# token — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Token information. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl token <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

Contents (14): search · info · holders · price-info · liquidity · hot-tokens · advanced-info · top-trader · trades · cluster-overview · cluster-top-holders · cluster-list · cluster-supported-chains · report

### token search
Search for tokens by name, symbol, or address
`ocl token search --query <QUERY> [options]`
- `--chains <CHAINS>` — Chains to search (comma-separated, e.g. "ethereum,solana")
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor — pass the cursor from the last item of the previous page
- `--max-results <MAX_RESULTS>` — Auto-paginate up to N total results (1-500, max 10 pages) → {items,nextCursor,fetchedCount}

### token info
Get token basic info (name, symbol, decimals, logo)
`ocl token info --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain

### token holders
Get token holder distribution (top 100)
`ocl token holders --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain
- `--tag-filter <TAG_FILTER>` — Filter by holder tag: 1=KOL, 2=Developer, 3=Smart Money, 4=Whale, 5=Fresh Wallet, 6=Insider, 7=Sniper, 8=Suspicious Phishing, 9=Bundler
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor — pass the cursor from the last item of the previous page
- `--max-results <MAX_RESULTS>` — Auto-paginate up to N total results (1-500, max 10 pages) → {items,nextCursor,fetchedCount}

### token price-info
Get detailed price info (price, market cap, liquidity, volume, 24h change)
`ocl token price-info --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain

### token liquidity
Get top 5 liquidity pools for a token
`ocl token liquidity --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. ethereum, base, bsc)

### token hot-tokens
Get hot token list ranked by trending score or X mentions (max 100 results)
`ocl token hot-tokens [options]`
- `--ranking-type <RANKING_TYPE>` — Ranking type: 4=Trending (token score), 5=Xmentioned (Twitter mentions) (default 4)
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain filter (e.g. ethereum, solana)
- `--rank-by <RANK_BY>` — Sort field: 1=price, 2=price change, 3=txs, 4=unique traders, 5=volume, 6=market cap, 7=liquidity, 8=created time, 9=OKX search count, 10=holders, 11=mention…
- `--time-frame <TIME_FRAME>` — Time frame: 1=5min, 2=1h, 3=4h, 4=24h
- `--risk-filter <RISK_FILTER>` — Hide risky tokens (true/false, default: true)
- `--stable-token-filter <STABLE_TOKEN_FILTER>` — Filter stable coins (true/false, default: true)
- `--project-id <PROJECT_ID>` — Protocol ID filter, comma-separated (e.g. 120596 for Pump.fun)
- `--price-change-min <PRICE_CHANGE_MIN>` — Min price change percent (can be negative, e.g. -5)
- `--price-change-max <PRICE_CHANGE_MAX>` — Max price change percent (can be negative, e.g. -5 for losers)
- `--volume-min <VOLUME_MIN>` — Min volume (USD)
- `--volume-max <VOLUME_MAX>` — Max volume (USD)
- `--market-cap-min <MARKET_CAP_MIN>` — Min market cap (USD)
- `--market-cap-max <MARKET_CAP_MAX>` — Max market cap (USD)
- `--liquidity-min <LIQUIDITY_MIN>` — Min liquidity (USD)
- `--liquidity-max <LIQUIDITY_MAX>` — Max liquidity (USD)
- `--transaction-min <TRANSACTION_MIN>` — Min transaction count (tradeAmount)
- `--transaction-max <TRANSACTION_MAX>` — Max transaction count (tradeAmount)
- `--txs-min <TXS_MIN>` — Min txs count
- `--txs-max <TXS_MAX>` — Max txs count
- `--unique-trader-min <UNIQUE_TRADER_MIN>` — Min unique traders
- `--unique-trader-max <UNIQUE_TRADER_MAX>` — Max unique traders
- `--holders-min <HOLDERS_MIN>` — Min holders
- `--holders-max <HOLDERS_MAX>` — Max holders
- `--inflow-min <INFLOW_MIN>` — Min net inflow USD
- `--inflow-max <INFLOW_MAX>` — Max net inflow USD
- `--fdv-min <FDV_MIN>` — Min FDV (USD)
- `--fdv-max <FDV_MAX>` — Max FDV (USD)
- `--mentioned-count-min <MENTIONED_COUNT_MIN>` — Min mention count (for Xmentioned ranking)
- `--mentioned-count-max <MENTIONED_COUNT_MAX>` — Max mention count
- `--social-score-min <SOCIAL_SCORE_MIN>` — Min social score
- `--social-score-max <SOCIAL_SCORE_MAX>` — Max social score
- `--top10-hold-percent-min <TOP10_HOLD_PERCENT_MIN>` — Min top-10 holder percent
- `--top10-hold-percent-max <TOP10_HOLD_PERCENT_MAX>` — Max top-10 holder percent
- `--dev-hold-percent-min <DEV_HOLD_PERCENT_MIN>` — Min dev hold percent
- `--dev-hold-percent-max <DEV_HOLD_PERCENT_MAX>` — Max dev hold percent
- `--bundle-hold-percent-min <BUNDLE_HOLD_PERCENT_MIN>` — Min bundle hold percent
- `--bundle-hold-percent-max <BUNDLE_HOLD_PERCENT_MAX>` — Max bundle hold percent
- `--suspicious-hold-percent-min <SUSPICIOUS_HOLD_PERCENT_MIN>` — Min suspicious hold percent
- `--suspicious-hold-percent-max <SUSPICIOUS_HOLD_PERCENT_MAX>` — Max suspicious hold percent
- `--is-lp-burnt <IS_LP_BURNT>` — LP burned filter (true/false, default: true)
- `--is-mint <IS_MINT>` — Mintable filter (true/false, default: true)
- `--is-freeze <IS_FREEZE>` — Freeze filter (true/false, default: true)
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `--cursor <CURSOR>` — Pagination cursor — pass the cursor from the last item of the previous page
- `--max-results <MAX_RESULTS>` — Auto-paginate up to N total results (1-500, max 10 pages) → {items,nextCursor,fetchedCount}

### token trades
Get token trade history on DEX, with optional tag and wallet filters
`ocl token trades --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain
- `--limit <LIMIT>` — Number of trades (max 500) (default 100)
- `--tag-filter <TAG_FILTER>` — Filter by trader tag: 1=KOL, 2=Developer, 3=Smart Money, 4=Whale, 5=Fresh Wallet, 6=Insider, 7=Sniper, 8=Suspicious Phishing, 9=Bundler
- `--wallet-filter <WALLET_FILTER>` — Filter by wallet address (comma-separated, max 10)
